name: S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe)
short: Dropout rates in depression trials were similar to placebo or antidepressants. A review says it is contraindicated in bipolar disorder; a case report describes mania with an SSRI.
text: In a meta-analysis of 23 randomized trials in depression (2,183 participants), dropout rates with SAMe did not differ significantly from placebo or antidepressants. A review states SAMe is safe for most patients but contraindicated in bipolar disorder, and a case report describes mania with psychotic features in a person taking SAMe together with an SSRI antidepressant.

quotes: No significant differences in dropout rates were observed across the three comparison categories.
citations.label: Limveeraprajak et al., 2024, Prog Neuropsychopharmacol Biol Psychiatry
citations.title: Efficacy and acceptability of S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAMe) for depressed patients: A systematic review and meta- analysis.

quotes: SAM is safe to use in most patients, but is contraindicated in those with bipolar disorder.
